$project-handoff

Write a concise handoff for a fictional settings project. Goal: explain rejected profile names. Implemented: error copy in src/profile-form.tsx. Branch: feature/profile-copy. Base commit: abc1234. Supplied evidence: npm run test:profile passed, 6 tests, in the local development environment. Browser checks were not run. No commit, push, or deployment happened. Remaining: check keyboard focus. The owner authorized only the local copy change.
